def process(waterBody2007, waterBody2008, waterBody2009) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = pd.concat([waterBody2007, waterBody2008, waterBody2009], ignore_index=True)

    # normalize
    df = df.copy()
    df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce')
    df['Sample Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Sample Date'], errors='coerce')
    df['month'] = df['Sample Date'].dt.month
    df['Violation'] = df['Violation'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    df['Beach Type Description'] = df['Beach Type Description'].astype(str).str.strip()

    # restrict years, summer months
    df = df[df['Year'].between(2007, 2009, inclusive='both')]
    df = df[df['month'].isin([6, 7, 8])]

    # exceedance indicator: Violation == yes
    df['exceed'] = (df['Violation'] == 'yes').astype(int)

    # monthly exceedance rate by beach type
    out = (df.groupby(['Beach Type Description', 'Year', 'month'])
             .agg(samples=('exceed', 'size'),
                  exceedances=('exceed', 'sum'),
                  exceedanceRate=('exceed', 'mean'))
             .reset_index())

    # keep only Fresh/Marine labels (sometimes could be other casing)
    out['Beach Type Description'] = out['Beach Type Description'].str.title()
    out = out[out['Beach Type Description'].isin(['Fresh', 'Marine'])]
    return out

def process(rainBoston, rainChatham, rainAmherst, rainAshburnham) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    def to_long(df: pd.DataFrame, region: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
        d = df.copy()
        # Drop summary rows like 'Min', 'Max', etc.
        d['Year_num'] = pd.to_numeric(d['Year'], errors='coerce')
        d = d[d['Year_num'].notna()].copy()
        d['Year'] = d['Year_num'].astype(int)
        d = d.drop(columns=['Year_num'])

        month_cols = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec']
        keep = ['Year'] + [c for c in month_cols if c in d.columns]
        d = d[keep]
        long = d.melt(id_vars=['Year'], var_name='monthName', value_name='rain')
        long['rain'] = pd.to_numeric(long['rain'].replace({'M': pd.NA, 'T': pd.NA, '': pd.NA}), errors='coerce')
        month_map = {'Jan':1,'Feb':2,'Mar':3,'Apr':4,'May':5,'Jun':6,'Jul':7,'Aug':8,'Sep':9,'Oct':10,'Nov':11,'Dec':12}
        long['month'] = long['monthName'].map(month_map).astype(int)
        long['region'] = region
        return long[['region','Year','month','rain']]

    all_long = pd.concat([
        to_long(rainBoston, 'Boston'),
        to_long(rainChatham, 'Chatham'),
        to_long(rainAmherst, 'Amherst'),
        to_long(rainAshburnham, 'Ashburnham'),
    ], ignore_index=True)

    # restrict years and summer months
    all_long = all_long[all_long['Year'].between(2007, 2009, inclusive='both')]
    all_long = all_long[all_long['month'].isin([6,7,8])]

    # Impute missing with median of that month across non-missing years within the same region
    all_long['rain_imputed'] = all_long['rain']
    med = (all_long.dropna(subset=['rain'])
           .groupby(['region','month'])['rain']
           .median())
    def fill(row):
        if pd.isna(row['rain_imputed']):
            return med.loc[(row['region'], row['month'])]
        return row['rain_imputed']
    all_long['rain_imputed'] = all_long.apply(fill, axis=1)

    return all_long

operators.customDisplayName: Reshape monthly_precipitations_{boston,chatham,amherst,ashburnham}.csv from wide (Year, Jan..Dec) to long format with columns [region, Year, month, rain]; drop non-year summary rows by coercing Year to numeric; convert 'M'/'T'/blank to NA then numeric; filter to years 2007-2009 and summer months (6-8); impute missing rain with per-(region,month) median across non-missing years; output includes both original rain and rain_imputed.

def process(waterBodyAll, rainLong) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    # Average rainfall across relevant regions by beach type
    fresh_regions = ['Boston','Chatham','Amherst','Ashburnham']
    marine_regions = ['Boston','Chatham']

    rain_fresh = (rainLong[rainLong['region'].isin(fresh_regions)]
                 .groupby(['Year','month'])['rain_imputed']
                 .mean()
                 .reset_index(name='avgRain'))
    rain_marine = (rainLong[rainLong['region'].isin(marine_regions)]
                 .groupby(['Year','month'])['rain_imputed']
                 .mean()
                 .reset_index(name='avgRain'))

    fresh_ex = waterBodyAll[waterBodyAll['Beach Type Description'] == 'Fresh'][['Year','month','exceedanceRate']]
    marine_ex = waterBodyAll[waterBodyAll['Beach Type Description'] == 'Marine'][['Year','month','exceedanceRate']]

    fresh = fresh_ex.merge(rain_fresh, on=['Year','month'], how='inner')
    marine = marine_ex.merge(rain_marine, on=['Year','month'], how='inner')

    # Pearson correlation over the 9 summer months (3 years x 3 months)
    fresh_corr = fresh['avgRain'].corr(fresh['exceedanceRate'])
    marine_corr = marine['avgRain'].corr(marine['exceedanceRate'])

    out = pd.DataFrame([
        {'beachType':'Freshwater', 'corr': fresh_corr, 'n': len(fresh)},
        {'beachType':'Marine', 'corr': marine_corr, 'n': len(marine)},
    ])
    out['absCorr'] = out['corr'].abs()
    out['higherAbsCorr'] = out['absCorr'] == out['absCorr'].max()
    return out.sort_values('absCorr', ascending=False)

operators.customDisplayName: Compute summer (Jun/Jul/Aug) Pearson correlation between monthly rainfall and exceedanceRate for 2007-2009: (1) aggregate imputed rainfall by averaging across Freshwater-influencing regions [Boston, Chatham, Amherst, Ashburnham] and separately Marine-influencing regions [Boston, Chatham] at [Year,month]; (2) join with waterBodyAll exceedanceRate for Fresh and Marine; (3) compute Pearson corr(avgRain, exceedanceRate) for each beach type across 9 (Year,month) points; output corr, absCorr, and sample size n.
